description.value: The fully renovated Coast Courtenay Hotel is a mid-size chain property in the heart of Courtenay on Vancouver Island, two blocks from the Strait of Georgia and steps from downtown shops and the Courtenay Riverway Heritage Park trail. It features an on-site restaurant (Plates Eatery, known for all-day breakfast), a seasonal outdoor pool, and pet-friendly rooms with kitchenette options suited to longer stays. The central location puts cyclists within walking distance of groceries, parks, and the broader Comox Valley trail network.
